feed_activities.uid: The activity's public identifier, the payload's `id`.
feed_activities.verb: The verb, as a plain string.
feed_activities.actor_type: The actor's morph alias. Null when the actor is unknown.
feed_activities.published_at: When the activity happened. The feed orders by it, and only shows activities whose time has come.
feed_activities.deleted_at: Set when an activity is soft-deleted, by `deleteFromFeed()` for example. Soft-deleted activities are not shown.

feed_snapshots.id: Primary key. Activities point here through `cached_{role}_id`.
feed_snapshots.label: The label from `toFeed()`.
feed_snapshots.shape: A fingerprint of the `toFeed()` output's structure. `storyfeed:trickle` refreshes rows whose fingerprint no longer matches.
feed_snapshots.created_at: When the snapshot was first written.
feed_snapshots.updated_at: When the snapshot was last written.
feed_snapshots.source_updated_at: The model's `updated_at` when the snapshot was taken, in UTC. An older model never overwrites a newer snapshot.
feed_snapshots.meta: The model's route key, when it differs from the primary key.

feed_groupings.activity_id: The activity this row places in a group.
feed_groupings.hash: The group's key on this axis. Activities sharing a `bucket` and `hash` form one group.
feed_groupings.winner: True on the row curation chose for `live()`. Null on rows that are never curated.

feed_participants.role: Which role the entity fills: `actor`, `object`, `target`, `context`, `origin`, `result` or `instrument`.
feed_participants.entity_id: The entity's key, as a string.
feed_participants.published_at: Copied from the activity. The entity index narrows matching activity IDs for `involving()`; final ordering is on the outer activity query.

feed_parties.key: The party's name as a slug, unless a key is given.
feed_parties.name: The party's label in the feed.

feed_batches.uid: The batch's identifier. A `batch` grouping row's `hash` holds it.
feed_batches.opened_at: The `published_at` of the batch's first activity.
feed_batches.closed_at: When the batch closed. Null while it is open.
feed_batches.activities_count: How many activities joined the batch.
feed_batches.closes_at: When the batch ends. Each activity moves it to its own `published_at` plus its verb's window, never earlier.
feed_batches.meta: Metadata about the batch, kept without adding a column.

feed_meta.key: `sync_token`, or one of the trickle's cursors.

feed_tombstones.id: Primary key. Activities point at a tombstone with the `storyfeed.tombstone` alias.
feed_tombstones.model_id: The deleted model's key, as a string.
feed_tombstones.restorable: True while the model is soft-deleted and can come back.
feed_tombstones.approximate: True when `storyfeed:trickle` found the deletion, so `deleted_at` is when it was found.
feed_tombstones.label: The label kept for the deleted model, when it keeps one.
feed_tombstones.meta: Metadata about the deletion, kept without adding a column.

feed_batch_locks.actor_id: The actor's key, as a string.
feed_batch_locks.open_batches: The ids of the actor's open batches.
feed_batch_locks.locked_at: When a publish last locked the row.
